source_origins.activation_calibration: 12 public prompts, 461 original BF16 token positions, 196 input-channel diagonal moments, no labels
source_origins.source_previous_v1_quality: original source-weight-only, NOT use old target PPL/argmax for optimization

solver.grouped_stage_binary_options: each of 28 layers selects 1/8 QKV combination, 1/4 gate-up combination, 1/2 output projection, and 1/2 FFN down projection; 448 binary variables and 112 one-of constraints
solver.local_quality_objective: maximize sum over selected role_layer of diagonal BF16 activation-weighted local quantization error reduction
solver.async_DAG: Q/K/V can overlap then joined by attention; O follows attention, gate/up can overlap after post-attn normalization; down follows gate/up; layers serial
solver.cost_choice: minimum measured 7-round source-role stage median; 3 independent Q4 pools avoid race
solver.serial_predicted_method: source 7-role native q4/8 additive delta, previous full-model Q4 75.26ms and role-matched 28n8 116.18ms calibration gamma=1.039406406482483
solver.async_stage_predicted_method: sum over decoder layers of measured best native QKV stage, measured best gate-up stage, measured O and down one-role kernels; not a full-model async ETA
solver.solver_engine: SciPy HiGHS mixed integer, require status=optimal and absolute constraint verification before freezing
solver.tie_breaking: fixed deterministic tiny linear index perturbation <=1e-9 and sorted output; report solver gap

quality_evaluation: After policy SHA freeze evaluate only fixed eight evaluation_public_only prompts from earlier Q v2 protocol; also old 21-token synthetic windows as diagnostic with explicit reuse flag. No optimization based on eval outputs.
validation_hierarchy: native full-model sequential engine first; actual async full-model scheduler considered separately only after correctness/race audit; native stage concurrency does not establish full model async speedup
safety: no production/main/release/model source edits, no blocked previous per-tensor final-logit intervention, no old V6/holdout, private model-derived data 0600, aggregate only public
limitations: Diagonal moment metric is not full-model response sensitivity
Stage CPU thread contention may change with different layer inputs/model cache
Any claim of full async runtime TPS requires actual full-engine concurrency integration and measurement
